name: Parakeet-unified-en-0.6b — Best Hyperparam Config (= Baseline, Sweep Was a Null Result) on Gold-92
short_description: Per-clip STT predictions from the hyperparameter-sweep 'winner' — which is the unchanged default config (alpha=1.0, depth_scaling=2.0), because every alternative alpha/depth_scaling combination tested either showed zero EA-DV movement (near-default) or catastrophically regressed WER (far-from-default). Identical file content to parakeet-unified-biasing-baseline.
model_description: nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b via NeMo ASRModel, greedy_batch decoding, GPU-PB TurboBias boosting_tree; hyperparameter sweep over alpha in [1.0-3.0] and depth_scaling in [2.0-4.0] (wide grid) plus a narrower follow-up (alpha 1.0-1.5, depth_scaling 2.0-2.5) found no config that improves EA-DV without breaching the +1.0pp WER regression cap.

files.description: Per-clip STT predictions on all 93 gold-92 clips at the sweep-selected (= default) config.
